column1:
2055-00-109-0001
District Executive
Force
(Establishment and
Committed
Expenditure)
column7:
Augmentation in provision
of ₹3,580.00 lakh was the
net effect of increase of
₹3,610.00 lakh and
decrease by re-
appropriation of ₹30.00
lakh. Increase was
attributed to need of
additional amounts in
travelling expenses,
awards, office expenses,
and legal charges.
Decrease was attributed to
anticipated saving. Final
saving of ₹1,11,351.81
lakh is understated by
₹941.23 lakh due to
clearance of OB suspense
related to previous years.
Reasons for actual final
saving of ₹1,12,293.04
lakh have not been
intimated (July 2025).
